statement: Produce an authoritative inventory of in-scope ESS repositories and their protection settings, so coverage can be stated for the group rather than for a sample.
rationale: The supported finding rests on two repositories out of an unenumerated population; the inventory converts a sample statement into a population statement.
resource_note: One analyst, estimated under a week. Estimate supplied by the assessment team, not measured.

statement: Identify the system of record for emergency identity changes and confirm whether the supplied export is complete for that path. Investigate first; do not change the process on the current evidence.
rationale: The interview and the export disagree and the evidence cannot distinguish an incomplete export from an undocumented exception path. Acting on either reading now would be acting on a guess.
resource_note: Half a day of IAM operations time to identify the system of record.

statement: Establish where completed privileged-access reviews are retained for research systems, and make the retention location part of the standard itself.
rationale: The standard states the requirement but names no system of record, so a completed review cannot be located even when it has been done.
resource_note: UNKNOWN - depends on whether a system of record already exists.

statement: For each access-review requirement, record which enumerated population it applies to and which query establishes that population.
rationale: The one HIGH-confidence finding in this engagement is the one with a documented enumerated population. Naming the population is what made it checkable.
resource_note: Estimated two days across the security and identity groups.

statement: Decide and write down how generated code is reviewed before it reaches a production branch, and name the owner of that guidance.
rationale: Informal use is already happening; the gap is written guidance and an owner, not tooling.
resource_note: Guidance drafting only. No tool, licence or purchase is implied by this recommendation.

statement: Hold the AI-readiness session with the IAM group that the engagement window did not accommodate, or record the cell as out of scope by agreement.
rationale: The cell was not assessed. Until it is, there is no finding to sequence a recommendation against.
resource_note: UNKNOWN - cannot be estimated before the cell is assessed.
